title: Broken Authentication - Preventing Auth Flaws in PHP Applications
author: Stefan Bogdanescu
excerpt: Learn how to prevent broken authentication vulnerabilities in PHP applications. Covers OWASP Top 10 auth flaws, password hashing with bcrypt/argon2, session security, and MFA.
